text: Coffee with Mabel this morning. She and Delroy are finally getting married, sometime in the spring, probably April. Her mum is already fussing about venues. Delroy's brother Kemal is best man, which apparently nobody saw coming.
Zoe rang. Her parents' 40th anniversary is end of the month and she's organising a surprise lunch. Phoebe is doing the cake. I should offer to drive her nan over on the day.
Lars says the wedding's off. He and Saskia split up a couple of weeks ago and he's moved back in with his dad for now. He sounded flat. Need to check in with him over the weekend.

Long catch up with Anil and Tanvi. They got engaged in Lisbon last month!! Tanvi wants a small do after Christmas, Anil wants the full three days. His mum is firmly on his side. They're looking at venues sometime next week. Tanvi's sister Kasia offered to help with the planning, which Tanvi is slightly dreading. Must get them a little engagement present.
Katarzyna - Kasia to everyone - starts at the new firm on Monday at 9. She's nervous because it's a big step up. Her partner Duc is taking the day off to do the school run.
Fern mentioned Yuki's dog Biscuit needs an op on his knee early March. Yuki's worried about the cost. Fern's going round tomorrow evening.

Dinner at Arjun's. His sister Anika is expecting, due over the summer, first grandchild on both sides so everyone's a bit giddy. Arjun's trying to learn to cook properly before then, he's doing a course on Thursday nights. Their dad keeps sending baby name suggestions to the family WhatsApp at 6am. Anika has muted it.
remind me to send Valentina a card for her and Luca's anniversary, it's the 12th
Simone's audition is Friday at 3pm. She's been practising the same piece for weeks and says she can barely sleep. Text her good luck Friday morning.
Bumped into Kenji at the station. He's off to Osaka for three weeks over the holidays to see his grandparents. Said his grandad hasn't been well since the summer.
Aisha and Keisha are doing a joint 30th sometime in November, not settled on a date yet. Keisha said Aisha has been dropping hints about a record player.
Pick up suit from dry cleaners Thursday before 6.

Alina told me her brother Farid got engaged on Saturday. She's thrilled, but her dad's taking it badly because he's never met the fiancée. Alina's meeting her properly soon, maybe next weekend. Don't forget to message Farid congrats. Alina also said she's finally booked her own trip to Vietnam for early March, two weeks, on her own.
Ilse is moving to Bristol at the end of the month for Hiroshi's job. She's keeping her role remote for now. Their cat Pudding is coming too, in the car, which she's dreading.
Rana's grandmother passed away on Tuesday. Funeral's sometime next week, family are still sorting it. I should drop round with food tomorrow afternoon.
Quick one: Dalia's results come out on the 21st at 10am. She thinks the second paper went badly. Ask her how it went that evening.

Saw Liam and Amara at the farmers market. They've been married ten years this Saturday and are going away to the Lakes for a long weekend. Their kids are staying with Amara's sister. Liam's planned the whole thing, she has no idea where they're staying. He wants us to keep it quiet if she asks. Also Liam has started cycling to work, three times a week.
Phoebe hates surprises. Note for later.
Mabel called back about the wedding. Date's set for Saturday 18 April at 2pm. Delroy wants a ceilidh. She asked if I'd do a reading, I said yes.
Kemal's ankle still isn't right after the five a side injury. He's got a physio appointment tomorrow morning and a scan sometime next month. Annoyed because it means no skiing at New Year.
Talked to Zoe after the anniversary lunch. Her dad cried during the speeches, her mum loved the photo album. Phoebe's cake collapsed slightly but nobody minded. Should send Zoe the photos I took.
Delroy's mum, Mrs Mensah, is turning 70 on the 3rd. He's planning a family dinner that Saturday at 7. He said she collects teapots so I might get her one.
Anika had her 20 week scan yesterday, all fine. She's finding the tiredness hard though and has had to cut down to four days at work. Arjun is fussing over her constantly.
Need to ring Uncle Hiroshi about the cottage booking before Friday lunchtime.

Yuki says Fern and her girlfriend Valentina are thinking of moving in together, maybe early next year. Fern's flat is too small so they're looking at Valentina's area. Fern grew up round there anyway.
Lars texted. He's started seeing a counsellor every Tuesday evening and says it's helping. Going to invite him to the pub quiz next week.

Duc mentioned Kasia's first week went well. Her boss is apparently lovely. Their son starts nursery after half term, so it's all change for them. Kasia's mum is coming over from Krakow to help in early December.

Tanvi rang in a state. Anil's mum has booked a venue for July without asking them. Tanvi doesn't want to start a row, but she's not happy. They've got a meeting with both families Sunday at 4. I should check in with Tanvi Monday.
Got the flat inspection on Wednesday at 11, and boiler service the week after. Landlord says the window will be fixed sometime this month.

Simone didn't get the part. She's gutted, but they offered her understudy, which is something. She wants to go for drinks sometime this week. Her girlfriend Rana says she's been quiet since and hasn't touched the piano. Rehearsals for the understudy start on the 4th at 10am, so at least she has something to aim for.
Kenji's back from Japan. His grandad's doing a bit better, out of hospital. Kenji brought me some green tea, need to thank him properly.
Farid and his fiancée Amara are planning a wedding for late summer. Alina's doing the flowers. Their dad has come round a bit after meeting her last weekend.
Arjun's birthday is Sunday. He's been on about wanting a decent chef's knife since starting the cooking course.
Keisha said the joint 30th is now the 22nd at 8pm at that bar near the canal. Aisha's sorting the playlist. Buy something from both of us? Ask Simone if she wants to chip in.
Note: Dalia passed!! Got a 2:1. She's starting the masters in January. Her mum is throwing a little celebration Saturday afternoon.

Ilse rang from Bristol. Move went OK apart from Pudding hiding under the bed for two days. Hiroshi's new job started Monday, he's working long hours and doesn't get back till 8 most nights. She's feeling a bit isolated and doesn't know anyone yet. Should FaceTime her at the weekend, and maybe visit sometime next month.
Saskia mentioned she's got a job interview at the hospital on Thursday at half 2. Physio post. She's surprisingly calm about it. She's also been doing pottery classes on Wednesdays.
Liam and Amara back from the Lakes. Apparently he proposed again, renewing their vows next summer! Amara's already making a Pinterest board. Liam's mum is crying about it to anyone who'll listen.
Aisha's nervous about her driving test next Tuesday at 8.40am. Third attempt. Her brother keeps teasing her about it which isn't helping. Don't forget to wish her luck Monday night.
Duc's dad is retiring end of the year after 35 years at the post office. Duc and Kasia are doing a party for him in January sometime. Duc wants a speech from the grandkids.
Zoe and Phoebe are going to Iceland in early February to see the northern lights. Phoebe's paying, it's Zoe's birthday present. Zoe has no clue yet.

Spent the evening with Mabel helping with seating plans. She's stressed out, her parents are divorced and won't sit near each other. Delroy is being no help apparently. Need to take her for a proper lunch next week, away from all the wedding stuff. Also she's gone vegan which makes the catering fun.
Valentina told me Luca bought her a necklace for their anniversary and she bought him the same book he already owns. They laughed about it. They're going to Rome in the spring to make up for it.
Kemal's sister Dalia lives in Leeds now, works at the university. Kemal goes up once a month.
Chat with Anika at the shop. She's decided not to find out the baby's gender. Arjun desperately wants to know. Her mum's knitting in yellow to be safe.
Book the vet for the dog's jabs, sometime before the end of next week.
Tanvi update: they compromised. Small ceremony in March, big party in July. Anil's mum is happy, Tanvi is relieved. Engagement party at theirs on the 15th, starting 7ish. Should bring something nice.
Hiroshi Yilmaz from Ilse's old work emailed about a freelance job. He said he'd call tomorrow morning around 10.

Kasia's mum arrived. Kasia says she's already reorganised the kitchen. Duc is hiding at work. Their son loves her though. She's staying until the middle of January, so Christmas is at theirs this year. Duc asked if I know anywhere that does Polish food for Christmas Eve.

Keisha's having a hard time at work, redundancy rumours since September. She has a meeting with HR on Friday at 11 and hasn't been sleeping. Her partner Lars is trying to keep her spirits up, and her mum keeps sending job adverts, which isn't helping. I should text her Friday afternoon to see how it went.
Rana's going back to work next week after the funeral. She said her aunt is staying with her mum for a bit. Want to check on her once she's settled back in.
Fern's 40th is in early May. Valentina is planning something big and secret, she asked for a list of Fern's old uni friends. Fern loves jazz, so possibly a band.
Alina's little girl had her first ballet show on Saturday. Apparently she waved to the audience the whole time. Alina's husband filmed it.
Weekend away cancelled, Kenji's cousin's wedding got moved to that Saturday so he can't come. Rebook for sometime in the new year.
Saskia got the hospital job! Starts on 2 January. She's moving closer to work too, maybe by spring. Must send her congratulations.

Phoebe told me her parents are celebrating their ruby anniversary at Easter, a big family thing in Cornwall. Her brother Liam is flying back from Canada for it. Her mum keeps calling about outfits. Phoebe and Zoe are going down together the Thursday before, driving overnight. I said I'd feed their cat Miso while they're away.
Simone's girlfriend Rana is allergic to nuts, remember for the dinner party.

Met Amara's dad at the barbecue. Retired engineer, mad about vintage cars, restoring an old Mini. Lovely man. Amara says he's having a hip operation sometime after Christmas and he's quietly terrified, though he won't admit it. Her mum is already planning the recovery like a military campaign. Ask Amara how it went once he's home.
Delroy and Mabel's engagement drinks are Friday from 6 at the Crown. I'm doing a toast. Arjun can't come, he's at his sister's.
Need to get the car MOT done by the end of the month, garage opens 8am. Maybe Monday.
